record.original_question: Produce numerical pictures of the Kapouleas examples of constant-mean-curvature surfaces with circular boundary.

evidence.quote: Problem 2.10 (3*). Give numerical pictures of the Kapouleas' examples with circular boundary.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A constant-mean-curvature (CMC) surface in Euclidean 3-space $\mathbb{R}^3$ is an immersed surface $\Sigma \subset \mathbb{R}^3$ whose mean curvature $H$ is a nonzero constant. Kapouleas constructed, by a singular-perturbation / gluing technique, families of compact immersed (generally non-embedded, non-rotational) CMC surfaces of high genus whose boundary is a single round circle lying in a plane, obtained by desingularizing configurations of Delaunay unduloid pieces and spherical pieces joined along small catenoidal necks.

Task: Produce explicit numerical visualizations (i.e., computed triangulated or parametrically rendered pictures) of these Kapouleas CMC surfaces with circular boundary. Concretely, for representative members of the family (varying genus and the combinatorial data of the underlying graph of Delaunay/sphere pieces), numerically solve the CMC boundary value problem
$$ H(\Sigma) \equiv 1, \qquad \partial \Sigma = S^1 \subset \{z = 0\}, $$
and render the resulting surfaces, exhibiting their geometric features (necks, unduloidal segments, near-spherical bubbles, lack of rotational symmetry).
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not locate published numerical visualizations of the specific Kapouleas CMC examples with circular boundary. Numerical methods (e.g., conjugate surface construction, Brakke's Surface Evolver) have produced pictures of various compact CMC surfaces, but no explicit visualizations of Kapouleas' circular-boundary family appear in the located sources, so the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Numerical Examples of Compact Constant Mean Curvature Surfaces
status_evidence.snippet: New examples of compact constant mean curvature surfaces have been constructed numerically, with a conjugate surface method allowing explicit construction.
status_evidence.claim: Numerical CMC constructions exist for some compact CMC surfaces but not specifically for Kapouleas' circular-boundary examples.

status_evidence.title: Constant mean curvature surfaces with circular boundary in R^3
status_evidence.snippet: Kapouleas constructed non-embedded examples with genus bigger than two of compact surfaces with constant mean curvature spanning a circular boundary.
status_evidence.claim: Existence of Kapouleas circular-boundary CMC examples is established, but the cited literature describes them analytically rather than via numerical pictures.
